title: Six- and eight-pointed stars of the Alcázar, Seville
subtitle: Hall of the Ambassadors, Alcázar of Seville

given.O: The centre of an eight-pointed star.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s CM022 drawing. The unit star and a square-root-of-three compass transfer fix the six-pointed stars and the full square repeat. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The 15 pt bands are represented by their centre lines. The palette is illustrative. No photograph was checked. The compass steps, their order and named points are ours.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data15/CM022: Alcázar of Seville
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The page cites Cahier and Martin page 22; Wade SPA 2219 and SPA 2319; John Rigby photograph 180, Hall of the Ambassadors; and Nick Crossling’s photograph of wood inlay in the Salón de Techo de Carlos V. These are the page’s attributions.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They cross at K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at K1. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: The line from O to K1 crosses the circle at F. Draw a vertical line through F. It crosses the horizontal line through O at M. Turn the vertical line round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a straight line through A and C. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the first circle at Z, above O. Draw a straight line through O and Z. Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOZ. Draw lines through O at 90° to these two new lines.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a circle with centre A through O. It crosses the first circle at Z, above O. Draw the line through O that halves the angle AOZ. Draw a line through O at 90° to this new line.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre O and opening AW. W is the first circle’s crossing at 120° from A. Draw a vertical line through J, where the new circle crosses the line from O to K1. It crosses the horizontal line through O at N.

Draw a circle with centre M and opening ON. It crosses the horizontal line at Q, right of M. Draw lines through Q parallel to the lines from O to Z and from O to W. Turn both lines round O by 90°, three times.

The vertical line through M crosses the line at 30° from OA at T. It crosses the new line slanting up to the right at V, above T. Draw a circle with centre V and opening MT. It crosses the vertical at X, above V.
Draw a horizontal line through X. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines frame the tile, with corners U1 to U4.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a horizontal line through X. Draw its copies turned by 90° and 180° round O. The upper corners of the tile are U1 and U2. The lower corners are U3 and U4.

steps.text: The upper tile side crosses the line through Q turned by 90° at E. Draw a line through E parallel to the line at 30° from OA. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a line through O at 90° to the line from O to K1. It crosses the last slanting line at P, above O. Draw a line through P parallel to line OZ. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join U1, U2, U3 and U4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side.
